dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……心が洗われるようだ」
dialogues.en: "Huh...... I feel like my heart's getting washed."
dialogues.text: "Huh...... I feel like my heart's getting washed."

dialogues.jp:
桜の花が散ったってニュースでやってたけど、
一見したところ、どれも満開だな。
dialogues.en:
I was so filled with worry this afternoon, but now I felt
like that was a long time ago.
dialogues.text:
I was so filled with worry this afternoon, but now I felt
like that was a long time ago.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が家に来ないから、なんとなく見に来た
けど……。
dialogues.en:
It was reported on the news earlier that the cherry blossom
died, but it looks like they're in full bloom to me.
dialogues.text:
It was reported on the news earlier that the cherry blossom
died, but it looks like they're in full bloom to me.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、暇だし。散歩がてら少し探してみるか」
dialogues.en:
I decided to go see them because Moe-sempai isn't coming to
my home today......
dialogues.text:
I decided to go see them because Moe-sempai isn't coming to
my home today......

dialogues.jp:
桜の木を見上げながら、公園の奥へと進んでい
く。
dialogues.en:
"I'm bored anyway. I'll walk around and look for the dead
trees."
dialogues.text:
"I'm bored anyway. I'll walk around and look for the dead
trees."

dialogues.en: I looked up at the trees as I walked deeper inside the park.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the trees as I walked deeper inside the park.

dialogues.jp: 視界が開け、目の前に大きな桜の木が姿を現す。

dialogues.en: Suddenly I saw a huge cherry blossom tree in front of me.
dialogues.text: Suddenly I saw a huge cherry blossom tree in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 驚いた。

まさか……こいつが“散った桜の木”だとは思
わなかった……。
dialogues.en: I was surprised.
dialogues.text: I was surprised.

dialogues.jp:
この島に数ある桜の木の中で、１番思い出のあ
る木。
dialogues.en: I didn't think this tree would be the dead tree......
dialogues.text: I didn't think this tree would be the dead tree......

dialogues.jp:
幼い頃“秘密基地”と呼んでいた場所。その場
所のシンボルだった木……。
dialogues.en:
Out of all the trees on this island, this one was the most
special one to me.
dialogues.text:
Out of all the trees on this island, this one was the most
special one to me.

dialogues.jp:
かつて、音夢やさくらと約束を交わし、最近で
は俺とことりの“秘密の場所”となっていた桜
の木。
dialogues.en:
I called it my hideout when I was a child. This tree was so
symbolic to me......
dialogues.text:
I called it my hideout when I was a child. This tree was so
symbolic to me......

dialogues.jp: 散っていたのは、その思い出の桜だった。
dialogues.en:
This was the spot I made promises with Nemu and Sakura.
Recently, this was where I secretly met Kotori.
dialogues.text:
This was the spot I made promises with Nemu and Sakura.
Recently, this was where I secretly met Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 頬をフワリと風がなでていく……。
dialogues.en: This dead tree holds so many of my memories.
dialogues.text: This dead tree holds so many of my memories.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「この匂いは、お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "This smell...... is that you, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "This smell...... is that you, oniichan?"

dialogues.jp:
機能面で人とは別の進化を遂げた生き物が、桜
の木の陰からひょっこりと顔をだす。
dialogues.en: An unusual creature appeared from behind the tree.
dialogues.text: An unusual creature appeared from behind the tree.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、なんでお前がここにいるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, why are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「桜を見にきたんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "I came to see the cherry blossom......"
dialogues.text: "I came to see the cherry blossom......"

dialogues.jp:
枯れてしまった桜に手をついて、さくらがどこ
か寂しげに木を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura touched the dead tree and looked up at it with a sad
face.
dialogues.text:
Sakura touched the dead tree and looked up at it with a sad
face.

dialogues.jp:
「不思議なこともあるもんだな……いや、枯れ
　ないほうが不思議なんだけどさ」
dialogues.en:
"Strange things happen, huh......? I guess the fact that it
didn't die for this long is even stranger."
dialogues.text:
"Strange things happen, huh......? I guess the fact that it
didn't die for this long is even stranger."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どんな夢も終わるんだよ……特に楽しい夢は」
dialogues.en: "Every dream ends eventually...... Especially fun dreams."
dialogues.text: "Every dream ends eventually...... Especially fun dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Dream?"
dialogues.text: "Dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夢だよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, dream."
dialogues.text: "Yes, dream."

dialogues.jp: どこか、今日のさくらは雰囲気が違う。
dialogues.en: Sakura was acting different today.
dialogues.text: Sakura was acting different today.

dialogues.jp:
なにがどうとかじゃなくて、ずっと一緒にいた
俺にだけ分かる雰囲気が。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't tell what was different, but I could feel it
because I've been with her for so long.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't tell what was different, but I could feel it
because I've been with her for so long.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへ……呼んだだけ」
dialogues.en: "Teehee...... I just wanted to call you that."
dialogues.text: "Teehee...... I just wanted to call you that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそれ？」
dialogues.en: "What's that all about?"
dialogues.text: "What's that all about?"

dialogues.jp:
枯れてしまった木に寄って、さくらと同じよう
に手をついてみる。
dialogues.en:
I walked toward the dead tree and touched it just like
Sakura was doing.
dialogues.text:
I walked toward the dead tree and touched it just like
Sakura was doing.

dialogues.jp: まだ生きてはいる。
dialogues.en: It's still living.
dialogues.text: It's still living.

dialogues.jp:
人でいう血の流れというのか、中を通っている
水の音が手に伝わってくるようだ。
dialogues.en:
I could feel the movement of the tree sap, flowing inside
the tree.
dialogues.text:
I could feel the movement of the tree sap, flowing inside
the tree.

dialogues.jp: ――ぽすっ。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "......Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "......Oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.jp:
背中にはりついているさくらが、なぜか震えて
いる。
dialogues.en: I felt Sakura trembling on my back.
dialogues.text: I felt Sakura trembling on my back.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「っ……お、兄ちゃん……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おまえ、泣いてるのか！？」
dialogues.en: "Are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "Are you crying?"

dialogues.jp:
振り返ろうとしたが、ぎゅっ、と抱きついた腕
がそれを許さない。
dialogues.en:
I tried to turn around, but she was holding on to me too
tight.
dialogues.text:
I tried to turn around, but she was holding on to me too
tight.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「枯れちゃったよ……桜が枯れちゃったんだ
　……ボク達の桜が……」
dialogues.en:
"It's dead...... The cherry tree's dead...... our tree's
dead......"
dialogues.text:
"It's dead...... The cherry tree's dead...... our tree's
dead......"

dialogues.jp:
確かに、この木は俺や音夢、さくらの大切にし
ていた木だ。
dialogues.en: Indeed, this tree was a special tree for Nemu, Sakura and I.
dialogues.text: Indeed, this tree was a special tree for Nemu, Sakura and I.

dialogues.jp: 思い出の場所。
dialogues.en: This was our special place.
dialogues.text: This was our special place.

dialogues.jp: さくらとの別れ。
dialogues.en: This is where Sakura said goodbye.
dialogues.text: This is where Sakura said goodbye.

dialogues.jp: 家出した音夢がいた場所。
dialogues.en: This is where I found Nemu after she ran away from home.
dialogues.text: This is where I found Nemu after she ran away from home.

dialogues.jp: ことりとの出会い。
dialogues.en: This is where I met Kotori.
dialogues.text: This is where I met Kotori.

dialogues.jp: そんな、色々な思い出を見つめていた木だ。
dialogues.en:
This tree has been a witness to all of those special
moments.
dialogues.text:
This tree has been a witness to all of those special
moments.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボク……海外に帰るんだ」
dialogues.en: "I'm...... going back overseas."
dialogues.text: "I'm...... going back overseas."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
今度こそ、小さくてか弱い腕を振りほどいて、
振り返る。
dialogues.en: This time, I shook off her thin arms and turned around.
dialogues.text: This time, I shook off her thin arms and turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ……ごめんね、今になって」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe...... I'm sorry I didn't tell you."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe...... I'm sorry I didn't tell you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.jp: さくらは笑っていた。
dialogues.en: Sakura was smiling.
dialogues.text: Sakura was smiling.

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: My heart ached.
dialogues.text: My heart ached.

dialogues.jp: 笑顔の下で泣いているのが分かる。
dialogues.en: I could tell she was crying underneath her smiling face.
dialogues.text: I could tell she was crying underneath her smiling face.

dialogues.jp: 「どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「決めてたんだ。桜が枯れたら帰るって……」
dialogues.en: "I decided I'd go back if these cherry blossom fell."
dialogues.text: "I decided I'd go back if these cherry blossom fell."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんな――」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「嘘だよ。ホントは元から５月までの約束だっ
　たんだ……ほんの少しの間だけだって」
dialogues.en:
"I'm kidding. I was only supposed to be here for 5
months...... Just for a little while."
dialogues.text:
"I'm kidding. I was only supposed to be here for 5
months...... Just for a little while."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクが無理を言って来たの」
dialogues.en: "I came here for a selfish reason."
dialogues.text: "I came here for a selfish reason."

dialogues.jp: 胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: My heart was still aching.
dialogues.text: My heart was still aching.

dialogues.jp: さくらは、俺に会いに来たんだ。
dialogues.en: Sakura came here to see me.
dialogues.text: Sakura came here to see me.

dialogues.jp: 今になって気づいてしまった。
dialogues.en: I finally realized.
dialogues.text: I finally realized.

dialogues.jp: コイツはそういう奴だ。
dialogues.en: She's that kind of girl.
dialogues.text: She's that kind of girl.

dialogues.jp: それなのに、俺はほとんどかまってやらなくて。
dialogues.en: But I didn't spend much time with her......
dialogues.text: But I didn't spend much time with her......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan?"

dialogues.jp: さくらの手が胸に触れる。
dialogues.en: Sakura touched my chest.
dialogues.text: Sakura touched my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクのこと好き？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like me?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like me?"

dialogues.jp: 真剣な瞳が俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: She looked up at me with a serious face.
dialogues.text: She looked up at me with a serious face.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……良かったぁ」
ほっ、とさくらが無い胸をなでおろす。
dialogues.en: She looked relieved.
dialogues.text: She looked relieved.

dialogues.jp: 「そっか、またお別れか」
dialogues.en: "So you're leaving again, huh?"
dialogues.text: "So you're leaving again, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「泣かない……もうボクは泣かない。大人になっ
　たんだよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not crying...... I'm not crying anymore. I'm a grownup
now."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not crying...... I'm not crying anymore. I'm a grownup
now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
これは悲しい別れだけど、二度と会えないって
ことじゃない。
dialogues.en:
It's sad to say goodbye, but it doesn't mean that I won't
see her forever.
dialogues.text:
It's sad to say goodbye, but it doesn't mean that I won't
see her forever.

dialogues.jp: いちいち悲しむことじゃない。
dialogues.en: I don't need to be too sad.
dialogues.text: I don't need to be too sad.

dialogues.jp: そうやって――。
dialogues.en: We told ourselves inside......
dialogues.text: We told ourselves inside......

dialogues.jp: ふたりともが悲しみを我慢する。
dialogues.en: Then we both tried to hold our sadness.
dialogues.text: Then we both tried to hold our sadness.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめんな……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なに謝ってるのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you apologizing to me?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you apologizing to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクもありがとう……えへへ、見送りには来
　なくてもいいからね」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you too...... Hehehe, you don't have to come and see
me off, alright?"
dialogues.text:
"Thank you too...... Hehehe, you don't have to come and see
me off, alright?"

dialogues.jp: フワリ――と。
dialogues.en: Just like the flower petal,
dialogues.text: Just like the flower petal,

dialogues.jp:
赤いスカートを翻して、舞い散る桜の花びらの
ようにさくらが後ろに下がる。
dialogues.en: Sakura lightly stepped back as her red skirt danced.
dialogues.text: Sakura lightly stepped back as her red skirt danced.

dialogues.jp: お別れだ。
dialogues.en: Goodbye.
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだひとつだけ忘れてた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I forgot one thing."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I forgot one thing."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……お前なぁ」
思わず肩が落ちた。
dialogues.en: I spoke with frustration.
dialogues.text: I spoke with frustration.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　なにかな？」
dialogues.en: "What? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What? What is it?"

dialogues.jp: とことこ、とさくらが戻ってくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura walked back toward me.
dialogues.text: Sakura walked back toward me.

dialogues.jp:
「うにゃとかじゃなくて、こういう時はとっと
　と居なくなるのがいいんだろうが……」
dialogues.en: "You're supposed to disappear in a scene like this......"
dialogues.text: "You're supposed to disappear in a scene like this......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あははは……なに音夢ちゃんみたいなこと言っ
　てるの？」
dialogues.en:
"Ahaha...... You're saying something that Nemu-chan might
say!"
dialogues.text:
"Ahaha...... You're saying something that Nemu-chan might
say!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢みたいか？
dialogues.en: I sound like Nemu?
dialogues.text: I sound like Nemu?

dialogues.jp: あー。

「こほん……ま、とにかくだ。こういう別れは、
　さっさと済ますもんだぞ。何せ――」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, you need to finish up quickly. What a......"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, you need to finish up quickly. What a......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「かったるいからねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Pain, right?"
dialogues.text: "Pain, right?"

dialogues.jp: 本気でだるそうにさくらが呟く。
dialogues.en: She completed my sentence with a tired look.
dialogues.text: She completed my sentence with a tired look.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夢はもう終わったんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "My dream's over now......"
dialogues.text: "My dream's over now......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんの大事な人にも伝えてあげて」
dialogues.en:
"You tell that to your special person. Tell her that happy
dreams will eventually end......"
dialogues.text:
"You tell that to your special person. Tell her that happy
dreams will eventually end......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どんなに幸せな夢にも、必ず終わりはあるん
　だって……」
dialogues.en:
"You can't keep dreaming too long. Someone's waiting for you
to wake."
dialogues.text:
"You can't keep dreaming too long. Someone's waiting for you
to wake."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「夢ばかりを見ていないで。現実に待っている
　人がいるんだから」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Are you talking about Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Are you talking about Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは萌先輩のことか？」
dialogues.en: "So...... I'll see you again in spring......"
dialogues.text: "So...... I'll see you again in spring......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ……また春に……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura!"

dialogues.jp:
問いただす言葉も、伸ばしかけた手もすりぬけ、
さくらが走り去る。
dialogues.en: Sakura ran off, ignoring my question and my extended arms.
dialogues.text: Sakura ran off, ignoring my question and my extended arms.

dialogues.jp: ２度と振り返らず。
dialogues.en: She never turned back.
dialogues.text: She never turned back.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今度会うときは、すっごい美人さんになって
　るからねぇ！」
dialogues.en: "I'll be prettier when I see you next time!"
dialogues.text: "I'll be prettier when I see you next time!"

dialogues.jp: 遠くから声が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I heard her voice from afar.
dialogues.text: I heard her voice from afar.

dialogues.jp: それが――２度目の別れだった。
dialogues.en: This was the second time we said goodbye.
dialogues.text: This was the second time we said goodbye.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらとの別れ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Farewell with Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Farewell with Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
桜が枯れたら帰る事にしていた──そんな事を
言って、さくらが別れを告げた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura told me goodbye. She said she was supposed to leave
when the cherry blossom died.
dialogues.text:
Sakura told me goodbye. She said she was supposed to leave
when the cherry blossom died.
